notice: Real places to look for research and internship opportunities. These are links, not listings: the pilot has no permission to ingest vacancy pages, so it points at the source instead of pretending to know what is open. Entries marked probe=true are checked live; the others block automated requests and are offered as links only.

channels.label: CEDARS careers - jobs and internships
channels.covers: internship schemes, career fairs, and the entry point to the job portals
channels.note: The university careers office. This page links out to the portals rather than listing vacancies itself, so treat it as a doorway, not a vacancy.

channels.label: HKU NETjobs portal
channels.covers: the portal where HKU students and new graduates search and apply for jobs and internships
channels.note: Behind an HKU login. The pilot cannot read it, and will not ask you to sign in for it - open it yourself with your own credentials.

channels.label: JIJIS - Joint Institutional Job Information System
channels.covers: job and internship listings shared across UGC-funded universities
channels.note: Run by the UGC-funded universities together. Some listings are public, others need your university account.

channels.label: Undergraduate Research Fellowship Programme
channels.covers: research internship scheme, eligibility, and the faculty contacts who set the deadlines
channels.note: The scheme page publishes eligibility but no deadline of its own: it sends you to the relevant Faculty Office. That is where the date comes from.

channels.label: Faculty of Engineering - research
channels.covers: research groups and areas in the faculty, useful for finding a lab to approach
channels.note: A research-interest page, not a recruitment notice. A group listed here is not necessarily hiring; ask the group directly.

channels.label: Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks
channels.covers: innovation and technology companies that host internships
channels.note: An external organisation, not part of HKU. Useful when you want industry experience outside the university.

channels.label: Cyberport
channels.covers: digital technology community and its internship and talent schemes
channels.note: Blocks automated requests, so the pilot cannot check it. Open it yourself; the link is offered as is.

channels.label: JobsDB Hong Kong
channels.covers: general Hong Kong job market, including part-time and internship listings
channels.note: A commercial job board. Listings are written by employers, not checked by the university; verify the company before you apply.

channels.label: LinkedIn Jobs
channels.covers: professional network job search, including internships at larger firms
channels.note: Needs an account. Blocks automated requests, so the pilot cannot check it.
